picks.why: World War I bird’s-eye view of the whole town with Lipowa Street running to the market square; torn print edges trimmed

gaps: P0–P4: no candidates. P6: only a palace facade (#5), a housing estate (#6), a night traffic shot (#7) and a low-quality overcast rooftop view toward St. Roch’s Church (#8); none shows the center well.
notes: #3 is only 1434 px wide. #1 is a 2020 photo of an exhibition banner reproducing a 1917 aerial (shows the Great Synagogue dome more clearly, but with banner sheen and stand poles); #2 (1940, view down Lipowa Street from a tower, 1280 px) is the other P5 alternative, but its church tower is cut off at the top edge.
